title: PR #47050 added the project-scoped rule snooze (mute) endpoint, which loads the issue/metric alert rule by id alone without scoping it to the project in the URL, so a user can mute alert rules in other organizations.

findings.explanation: The code uses Django ORM methods (`.objects.get`, `.objects.filter`, `.objects.fetch_for_project`) which utilize parameterized queries and do not concatenate user input into SQL strings. No raw SQL is present in the diff.

The change refactors rule retrieval to explicitly scope the query to the current project (`fetch_for_project(project)` or `filter(project=project)`). This prevents IDOR (CWE-639) by ensuring a user cannot access or modify rules belonging to other projects/organizations, even if they guess the `rule_id`. The previous implementation fetched by ID alone, which was potentially vulnerable if the project context wasn't strictly enforced elsewhere, but this change hardens the access control.
